assessment.finding: AuroraPIC's 16-bin post-collision J.E diagnostic understates its exact electron electric work by 6.27 percent. Substituting the exact candidate ledger removes 29.76 percent of the apparent power-per-electron deficit, but leaves a 12.89 percent alternate-estimator deficit.
assessment.next_target: Generate 200-bin pre-collision AuroraPIC moments and compare their integrated J.E against both the exact candidate ledger and the locked 200-bin pre-collision eduPIC matrix.

claim_boundary: The exact AuroraPIC work ledger and eduPIC's phase-binned J.E matrix are different estimators. Their ratio localizes diagnostic bias but is not a matched cross-code validation or experimental-accuracy result.
